study.title: A Field Weed Density Evaluation Method Based on UAV Imaging and Modified U-Net
study.short_title: Field Weed Density Evaluation with Modified U-Net

segmentation.best_model: Modified U-Net (VGG16 backbone with HDC dilated convolutions)

dataset.name: UAV RGB imagery of experimental marigold field, Shangzhuang station, China Agricultural University, Beijing
dataset.note: DJI Mavic 2 (5472x3648 raw); 20 m flight height, 5 mm/pix mosaicked GSD (12,750x12,750); 100 x 256x256 samples augmented to 500 (400 train / 50 val / 50 test); binary crop-vs-others labeling; weeds derived by removing crop from ExG_ExR green-plant mask.

mIoU.quote: After training, the mean pixel classification accuracy of the model was 98.84%, the IoU was 93.40%, precision was 93.40%, recall rate was 80.85%
mIoU.ambiguity: IoU 93.40% is the crop-segmentation (binary) IoU of the proposed modified U-Net on the test set; the IoU reported in the abstract (93.40%) matches Table 2 (precision printed as 84.29).

F1.ambiguity: F1 can be derived from precision 84.29% / recall 80.85% (~82.5%) but is not explicitly reported.

PA.quote: After training, the mean pixel classification accuracy of the model was 98.84%, the IoU was 93.40%, precision was 93.40%, recall rate was 80.85%
PA.ambiguity: Mean pixel classification accuracy (Acc) of binary crop segmentation on the test set.

weed_F1.ambiguity: Weed mask produced by subtracting crop from green-plant threshold; no separate weed metrics.

crop_F1.ambiguity: Precision 84.29% / recall 80.85% for crop class reported; F1 not given.

fps.ambiguity: Single-image segmentation time on desktop GPU only; no on-board deployment.

latency_ms.quote: the IoU, accuracy, precision, recall, and segment time of the proposed modified U-net were 93.40%, 98.84%, 84.29%, 80.85%, 40.90 ms, respectively
latency_ms.ambiguity: Segmentation time of a single 256x256 image on a desktop NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 Super (Intel i7-9700K); NOT an embedded/edge deployment.
